original_idea.body:
# Follow-Up to DARPA AIxCC 37%→86% Jump: What Architectural Changes Drove the Improvement?

**Problem:** AIxCC vulnerability detection improved from 37% to 86% in one year. The SoK paper describes architectures but does not attribute the performance jump to specific design decisions.

**Direction:** Analyze the published SoK AIxCC paper (arXiv 2602.07666) and team write-ups from Trail of Bits (Buttercup) to extract architectural components. Design a small ablation experiment: implement a minimal CRS with and without the highest-impact component (hypothesize based on analysis). Test on a public CVE benchmark. Measure performance delta.

**Why it matters:** Understanding what drove the performance jump enables targeted improvement and informs what components should be prioritized in future defensive systems.

**Relevant context:** AIxCC SoK (arXiv 2602.07666). Trail of Bits Buttercup writeup. Team Atlanta victory analysis (OODA Loop 2025). Attribution of improvement to specific components not published.
